Try a trimmed_mean on the full pool, hoping to reduce influence of very high-error models in the tail, given moderate ranking stability.

The series has a strong trend and moderate ranking stability; a DBA (differential back‑adaption) might better exploit the trend dominance and combine complementary models.

test a simple mean over the selective pool (trend dominated, moderate stability) to see if averaging improves over weighted.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.1784. Series context: trend strength 0.8014 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.665); 12 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 154695629337511.34.
